_source.text: 984. JOHN JOHNSON was indicted for stealing, on the 5th of March , 1 stove, value 14s. , the goods of Stephen Horncastle Geldard . STEPHEN HORNCASTLE GELDARD . I live in Pullen's-row, Chelsea - I have the care of a house called Ranelagh cottage ; it is unoccupied; there are stoves and other fixtures in it. I was there about twelve o'clock in the day on the 5th of March; I fastened the doors when I left; I received some information in about half an hour, and returned; I looked through the parlour
_source.title: JOHN JOHNSON. Theft; simple larceny (from 1827). 7th April 1831.

text: - he was afterwards taken - the stove had been taken out of its place, and set behind the parlour door; I had lost a grate from the same house on the Saturday before - a key was given to me by one of the witnesses, which opened the door very easily. BENJAMIN FOSTER . I live in Paradise-street, St. Luke's, and am a labourer. _source.text: 986. JOHN DAVIS was indicted for stealing, on the 24th of March , 1 African dress robe, value 3l. , the goods of Maria Lardner . MARIA LARDNER . I live in Acre-cottage, Camden-town , and am a widow . The prisoner was in my son's service; he is an officer in the Second West India Regiment - in September last my son and the prisoner left my house to go abroad, but in a few days the ship got leaky, and returned to Margate; my son went to an hotel, the prisoner left him, and came back to my house -
_source.title: JOHN DAVIS. Theft; simple larceny (from 1827). 7th April 1831.

text: robe of an African chief, which my son had brought from abroad, and made me a present of - I went to the house of Martha Baggs , and got the robe from her. GEORGE BROWN . I am a livery-stable keeper and hackney-master , and keep the Black Bull, Gray's Inn-lane . On the 29th of April I was called up by two Policemen, between two and three o'clock; I got up and went to my stable - I found a brown mare gone, and another standing in
_source.title: GEORGE SMITH. Theft; animal theft. 12th May 1831.
